title: Emit worker task notifications via Mastra Signals
description: Wire managed task lifecycle hooks in task-registry to sendNotificationSignal (worker_response/worker_progress mapping). Record dispatch in intake ledger when MAST-54 lands. Use stable dedupeKey/coalesceKey per design; route thread via conversation captured at delegate time.
why: The assistant must learn task completion and meaningful progress without polling assistant-tasks.db.

acceptance.text: task-registry emits sendNotificationSignal for terminal states and coalesced progress

outcome.summary: Implemented in c3ce454: intake ledger, worker bridge, inbox tool, reconcile on bootstrap, http handler.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run test:signals; npm run check
